name: Matsubayashi Asami
source:
Touzaka University 4th Year, Literature Major, Art Club member.

"Love, if it even exists, will decay... And when it does, what's left?"

Due to being singlehandedly raised by her mother, Asami has a cynical opinion of love and marriage. She believes that everything can be done without a man in the house. A strong person, but occasionally negative and untrusting of others. She is good at hiding her emotions but has chosen to turn to the arts and humanities to express herself instead. Currently doing an internship at Edo Publishing in the editorial department.

[From [url=https://precatio.wordpress.com/characters/]official site[/url]]
